verdict.rationale: The SOS public pages list a CCFS Search for business records and an Apostille Search, which suggests public lookups of entity records and apostille requests. The evidence is only link titles, though, with no description of whether pending filing, application, or case status is shown. Missing for 10: documented lookup of pending filing or application status, any detail on what CCFS Search returns (e.g., entity status or filing history), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
